Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) workflow using DDA and LFQ to identify protein interaction partners for four specific bait proteins.

scope: immunoprecipitations followed by tandem mass spectrometry [IP-MS/MS]
For each individual experiment, 1–2 mg of protein extract was incubated at 4 °C overnight in the presence of 1–2 μg of the relevant antibody.
50 μL of Protein G beads (Pierce) were added to each sample
All immunoprecipitated samples (n = 48) and IgG controls (n = 12) were in PBS buffer on beads.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is an affinity purification mass spectrometry (AP-MS) study focused on mapping protein-protein interactions (interactomes) across different cell types. The primary comparison is between the bait-specific immunoprecipitation and the IgG control to identify significant interactors. While the study compares different cell types (neuronal vs cancer), this is a descriptive cell-type comparison rather than a perturbation/treatment experiment. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
